name: Stratum
description: An open source silicon-independent switch operating system for SDN. Reference implementation of P4Runtime and gNMI services as a hardware abstraction layer for network switches.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker dev environment via ./setup_dev_env.sh. Pre-built container with Mininet and Stratum BMv2: docker run --privileged --rm -it -p 50001:50001 opennetworking/mn-stratum

eval_notes: P4-programmable switch OS with Docker support. The mn-stratum image bundles Mininet + bmv2 for instant P4 lab environments. Good for testing programmable data plane scenarios.
